title: Khatu Shyam Janmotsav Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Khatu Shyam Janmotsav: Baba ke darshan

scenes.prompt: Close-up devotional darshan of the divine Sheesh (head only, no body, no flute) of Shri Khatu Shyam ji: a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden mukut with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered white, pink, blue and orange flower garlands and jewels, in a decorated sanctum, face in the middle of the frame, soft golden evening glow
scenes.tts: खाटू श्याम जन्मोत्सव आ रहा है। बाबा के दर्शन कीजिए।
scenes.sub: Khatu Shyam Janmotsav aa raha hai. Baba ke darshan kijiye.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: A temple sanctum entrance decorated with marigold garlands and rows of lit clay diyas in the evening, warm golden light, no people
scenes.tts: देव उठनी एकादशी पर बाबा का जन्मोत्सव मनाया जाता है।
scenes.sub: Dev Uthani Ekadashi par Baba ka Janmotsav manaya jata hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly and a few marigold petals drift down in the warm light

scenes.prompt: Close-up of the divine Sheesh (head only, no body, no flute) of Shri Khatu Shyam ji: a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden mukut with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered white, pink, blue and orange flower garlands and jewels, in a decorated sanctum, glowing diyas in the foreground
scenes.tts: भक्त उन्हें हारे का सहारा कहकर पुकारते हैं।
scenes.sub: Bhakt unhe Haare ka Sahara kehkar pukarte hain.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames glow and flicker softly

scenes.prompt: A quiet temple courtyard at dusk with saffron flags fluttering gently and a lamp-lit pathway, warm golden sky, no people
scenes.tts: बीस नवंबर को श्याम दरबार में उत्सव होगा।
scenes.sub: Bees November ko Shyam darbar mein utsav hoga.
scenes.animate: the saffron flags flutter softly in the breeze and the lamp flames flicker gently

scenes.tts: कल गोवर्धन पूजा के लिए लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। जय खाटू श्याम!
scenes.sub: Kal Govardhan Puja ke liye Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Jai Khatu Shyam!
